case_number: 2024 INSC 630; CIVIL APPEAL NOS.2842-2848 OF 2012, WITH CIVIL APPEAL NO.2781/2012, CIVIL APPEAL NO.2782/2012, CIVIL APPEAL NO.2783/2012, CIVIL APPEAL NO.2841/2012, CIVIL APPEAL NO.2829-2840/2012, AND CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2024
summary: Service tax on lottery ticket distribution; business auxiliary service under Finance Act, 1994 s.65(19)(ii) and s.65(105)(zzb); State List List 2 Entry 40 vs Union List Entry 97; actionable claim vs service; Sunrise Associates precedent distinguished; marketing/promotion services constitute taxable activity; sale on outright/no-return basis irrelevant to service tax liability; High Court judgments upheld; constitutional validity of Explanation to s.65(19)(ii) confirmed; service tax liability established.
legal_provisions_cited: Kerala Tax on Paper Lotteries Act, 2005
Sunrise Associates vs. Govt. of NCT of Delhi (2006) 5 SCC 603
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgments upheld; service tax liability confirmed.
